items.title: Armed bandits kill about 140 people in Plateau State, Nigeria. Many houses are burned down.
Countries around the Indian Ocean hold commemorations on the fifth anniversary of the earthquake and tsunami that killed around 250,000 people.
M 7.1 - 30 km SW of Hengchun, Taiwan

Between 200 and 500 people have been killed in an oil pipeline explosion in Nigeria's commercial capital, Lagos, according to the Red Cross. The blast is believed to have been caused by thieves puncturing the pipeline in an attempt to siphon off fuel into a tanker.

Memorial services around the world, including one in Banda Aceh, Indonesia, attended by President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono, mark the first anniversary of the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami which saw 275,000 people killed or left missing.
M 7.2 - 284 km WNW of Sabang, Indonesia
Malaysia: The 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami killed about 130,000 people including more than 70 Malaysians. The tsunami was observed in Kedah, Penang and Perak.
Iran: The 6.6 Mw Bam earthquake shook southeastern Iran with a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent), leaving more than 26,000 dead and 30,000 injured.
M 7.8 - 146 km ESE of Hihifo, Tonga
M 7.8 - 20 km NNE of Erzincan, Turkey
